## Install

1. Download `CheatIME-<version>.dmg` below, open it, and drag **CheatIME** to **Applications**.
2. CheatIME is not notarized by Apple, so macOS blocks the first launch. Open it once, then go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**. Or run:
   ```sh
   xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/CheatIME.app
   ```

Requires macOS 15 or later (Apple silicon and Intel). `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists the checksums of the files below.

See the [README](https://github.com/HikiJun97/CheatIME#readme) for details. 한국어 · 日本語 · 简体中文 instructions are linked from there.
